name: color
description: Sets the text color of an element.
notes: Accepts named colors, hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), and currentColor.

name: background-color
description: Sets the background color of an element.

name: background-image
description: Sets one or more background images or gradients on an element.

name: background-size
description: Controls how a background image is scaled within its container.

name: background-position
description: Sets the starting position of a background image within its container.

name: background
syntax: background: color image position/size repeat attachment;
description: Shorthand for setting all background-related properties in a single declaration.
notes: Omitted values reset to their defaults, so be careful mixing this with individual background-* overrides.

name: font-family
description: Specifies a prioritized list of fonts to use for text.
notes: Always end the list with a generic family (serif, sans-serif, monospace) as a fallback.

name: font-size
description: Sets the size of the font used for text in an element.

name: font-weight
description: Sets the boldness/thickness of text.

name: font-style
description: Sets whether text is displayed in italic, oblique, or normal style.

name: line-height
description: Sets the height of a line box, controlling vertical spacing between lines of text.
notes: A unitless number is preferred — it scales relative to the element's own font-size instead of inheriting a fixed pixel value.

name: text-align
description: Sets the horizontal alignment of inline content within a block-level element.

name: text-decoration
description: Sets decorative lines on text, such as underlines or strikethroughs.

name: text-transform
description: Controls the capitalization of text without changing the underlying markup.

name: letter-spacing
description: Sets the horizontal spacing between text characters.

name: margin
description: Sets the space outside an element's border, separating it from neighboring elements.
notes: Vertical margins between block elements can collapse into a single margin — the larger of the two.

name: padding
description: Sets the space between an element's content and its border.

name: border
description: Shorthand for setting an element's border width, style, and color in one declaration.
notes: A border-style must be set (e.g. solid) or no border renders, even with a width and color.

name: border-radius
description: Rounds the corners of an element's border box.

name: box-shadow
syntax: box-shadow: offsetX offsetY blur spread color;
description: Adds one or more drop shadows around an element's box.
parameters: offsetX/offsetY — shadow position. blur — softness. spread — size. color — shadow color. inset (optional) draws it inside the box.

name: opacity
description: Sets the transparency of an entire element, including its content and children.
notes: Unlike a transparent background-color, opacity fades the whole element and creates a new stacking context.

name: overflow
description: Controls what happens to content that overflows an element's box.

name: overflow-x / overflow-y
description: Independently controls overflow behavior on the horizontal and vertical axes.

name: visibility
description: Hides an element while still reserving its layout space, unlike display: none.

name: cursor
description: Sets the mouse cursor style shown when hovering over an element.

name: box-sizing
description: Determines whether padding and border are included in an element's declared width and height.
notes: border-box is the common reset choice — it makes width/height calculations far more predictable.

name: display
description: Sets the fundamental rendering box type of an element (block, inline, inline-block, or none).
notes: display: flex and display: grid switch the element into their own layout modes — see the Flexbox and Grid categories.

name: width / height
description: Sets the explicit width or height of an element's content box (or border box with box-sizing: border-box).

name: max-width / min-width
description: Constrains an element's width to not exceed or fall below a given value, overriding a conflicting width.

name: white-space
description: Controls how whitespace and line breaks inside an element are handled.

name: text-overflow
description: Sets how overflowed, clipped text is signaled to the user, most commonly with an ellipsis.
notes: Requires overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap to take effect.

name: list-style
description: Shorthand for controlling the marker type, position, and image of list items.

name: outline
description: Draws a line around an element outside its border, without affecting layout or box size.
notes: Unlike border, outline doesn't take up space in the box model, so it won't shift layout.

name: vertical-align
description: Sets the vertical alignment of an inline or table-cell element relative to its line or row.
notes: Only applies to inline, inline-block, and table-cell elements — has no effect on block-level elements.

name: content
description: Defines what is inserted by the ::before and ::after pseudo-elements.
notes: Only has an effect when used with ::before or ::after.

name: filter
description: Applies graphical effects like blur, brightness, or grayscale to an element.

name: resize
description: Controls whether and how an element can be resized by the user, typically for textareas.

name: pointer-events
description: Controls whether an element can be the target of mouse/pointer interactions.
notes: Setting none lets clicks pass through to elements underneath, which the element visually still covers.
